title: pi-better-edit configuration
description: Settings file for pi-better-edit. Global: ${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/extensions/pi-better-edit/settings.json (or <PI_BETTER_EDIT_CONFIG_DIR>/settings.json when that variable is set); project: <cwd>/.pi/agents/pi-better-edit/settings.json. A settings file left at a retired location is adopted once and renamed .bak.

store.description: Storage housekeeping. The state DIRECTORY is not configurable here: PI_BETTER_EDIT_CONFIG_DIR owns it — read verbatim, and with it set state lives in <override>/state/ — so no file can move the store. Without it the state root is ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/pi-better-edit.

multiFile.description: Multi-file bash view caps (ADR-0049 M6). Values outside the range are ignored with a warning and fall through the ladder.
